events.notes: A matching comment may fire without facts. Priority and latency are initial tuning values.

events.trigger: The first death attributed to enemy ID 'deathsquito' for this character/world pair.
events.notes: Legacy/specific event retained for ID stability. Prefer the generic death_first_by_enemy where applicable. Facts enrich advice only and never block a comment.

events.trigger: The first death attributed to a recognized enemy ID for this character/world pair and enemy.
events.notes: Resolve oncePerKey and factsOptional using the normalized enemyId. Missing/unverified facts do not block comments; only verified facts may support advice.

events.trigger: The first death attributed to 'deathsquito' within the configured post-boss window after the tracked 'moder' defeat, for this character/world pair.
events.notes: Special higher-priority case. Store the boss-defeat timestamp per character/world and compare it with death time. The window is configurable. Verify identifiers/timing; facts do not gate comments.

events.trigger: The first death with a recognized cause within the configured window after a tracked boss defeat.
events.notes: Store timestamps per character/world and bossId. Require a known causeId; never infer one. The Moder/Deathsquito special case has higher priority.

events.trigger: The character/world death count reaches 3.
events.notes: Milestone values are project settings, not game-mechanic claims.

events.trigger: The character/world enters a recognized dungeon or interior type for the first time.
events.notes: Uses the biome group as the allowed location-discovery group. The once-only flag is per interiorType.

events.trigger: A recognized boss-defeat event occurs.
events.notes: Persist this flag and defeat timestamp per bossId and character/world. Do not assume a boss list or progression order.

events.trigger: The character/world records its first encounter with a curated notable enemy ID.
events.notes: Fire only for IDs in this curated allowlist, never every critter. Normalize the runtime prefab name before matching. Missing/unverified facts do not block a comment.

events.trigger: A hit is confirmed and runtime damage-modifier data confirms the enemy resists that damage type.
events.notes: Runtime field and enum names are unverified hypotheses; confirm in HOOK_NOTES.md. Do not fall back to guessed weakness data. Cooldown is provisional.

events.trigger: A verified game signal indicates the player's boat was wrecked.
events.notes: The hook and event meaning must be confirmed in-game. Missing/unverified facts do not block a comment. Cooldown is provisional.

events.trigger: A verified game signal indicates food was burned at a cooking station.
events.notes: The hook and event meaning must be confirmed in-game. Missing/unverified facts do not block a comment. Cooldown is provisional.

events.trigger: A verified game signal indicates a fishing line snapped.
events.notes: The hook and event meaning must be confirmed in-game. Cooldown is provisional.

events.trigger: A death occurs after a trip that meets a configurable long-trip criterion.
events.notes: Trip duration/context and threshold are design inputs. Do not fire when travel context is unavailable. Cooldown is provisional.

events.trigger: A probability roll succeeds while no higher-priority event is active.
events.notes: Probability and cooldown are tuning placeholders. Ambient comments should not require a live call.

events.trigger: The player submits a push-to-talk transcript as a question.
events.notes: Transcribe locally. Send only the transcript when a provider response is enabled/needed; verified facts enrich advice but do not gate comments.
